featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Rage Room in Sakinaka, Mumbai, and it was amazing! If you need to escape the city's craziness and let out some frustration, this is the place to go.

The staff was friendly and explained everything well. They gave us protective gear and different tools to smash things like glasses, tubelights, tea cups and glass bottles. It was really satisfying to break stuff!

For someone like me, who gets stressed from work it was the perfect way to let off steam. My partner and I also had a great time, and it was a fun and different date night idea.

The room is set up to keep you safe while you smash things. It has proper safety gloves, shoes, dresses, helmets, and they give you clear instructions. We spent about 30 minutes there, and it was full of smashing and laughter. We felt relaxed and happy afterward.

If you want to try something fun and different in Mumbai, I highly recommend the Rage Room in Sakinaka. It's great for relieving stress or just having a good time.

featured_reviews.review_text:

We were given all the safety gears and equipment from gloves, helmets to face shields and shoes as well in case you didn't wear one. They offered us a range of bottles, glasses and even tubelight with a smashing wall right in front of us. There were hammers as well to channelise your inner Triple H.

We were given 30 minutes to get going. There was a speaker where you could play music with a bluetooth connection. It was so well organised that you didn't have to wait for anything. They also offer you a TV to break if you pay an extra amount.

We didn't have to wait for a long time as we got our slot booked and will advise others to do the same on their website. You can find more about our experience at TheHoggerBloggers on Instagram.

featured_reviews.name: Vaishali Bhayani Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its' a very thoughtful 6 storeyed museum. Many interesting activities for age groups 5 to adults. Activities are classified in three groups -
1) Ages 2-7
2)Ages 8-10
3) Age 10 & upwards
There is a floor about Automobiles explaining everything about cars, their history, their working mechanism and a simulator
There is a Grow Lab, Think Lab, Discover Lab, Terrace, etc. There is a Café on level 1 and a library on level 6. There is a laser printing lab, where kids can make a card paper chocolate box along with their name imprinted on it.
3 hrs is sufficient for kids aged 7. For older kids, may be 5 hrs would do as they would explore more independently.

The volunteers and staff also need to be well-equipped to respond to questions posed by the visitors - both adults & kids

featured_reviews.name: Sunita Deulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Muso – Museum of Solutions is a great destination if you're looking for a full day of learning, play, and exploration. It’s very easy to reach — just get down at Lower Parel station, and the museum is within comfortable walking distance.

The overall concept of the museum is impressive. You can purchase a full-day pass, which I highly recommend, as there is a lot to experience across multiple floors. Each floor is thoughtfully designed with different themes and hands-on activities. The Science Lab, Play Lab, and Discover Lab each offer unique, interactive experiences that keep children (and even adults!) fully engaged. The exhibits encourage creativity, problem-solving, and curiosity, making it an ideal place for both fun and learning.

There’s also a cafeteria on the first floor, which is convenient when you want to take a break and grab a quick bite without leaving the premises.

The only area that could be improved is on-ground guidance. With so many activities and floors, having more staff members available to guide visitors, coordinate activities, and offer directions would definitely enhance the overall experience.

Apart from that, Muso is a beautifully designed, modern space that truly inspires imagination. A great place to spend quality time with kids, explore, learn, and enjoy a full day of discovery. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place recently and the experience was quite disappointing.
First, it is definitely not walking distance in the scorching heat from Lower Parel if you have a 2 PM slot. Even locals around the area hadn’t heard of it, so don’t rely on getting proper directions.

We had picked up some quick bites assuming we could have them in the lobby before starting our slot. To our shock, they didn’t allow my child to eat there and asked her to sit near security to finish her dry snacks — extremely unreasonable. Strangely, when we returned, we saw kids openly eating popcorn in the lobby. The rules felt inconsistent and frankly outrageous.

Coming to the activities — hugely overhyped and absolutely not worth the money. KidZania is 100 times better in comparison. The Water Lab was a complete waste and many of the equipment pieces clearly needed maintenance.

Overall, not worth the hype or the cost. Definitely needs better management, clearer rules, and major improvements.

featured_reviews.name: Satyan Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
A must-visit in Mumbai for curious minds of all ages!
​The Museum of Solutions (MuSo) is an incredible, well-thought-out space where both kids and adults can learn something new. Each floor has a unique, engaging theme:
​VRoom: Fascinating insights into automotive history and modern growth.
​Play Lab: Pure fun! Kids will absolutely love all the hands-on activities here.
​Discover Lab: Great for encouraging curiosity, helping kids explore the "why" behind how things work.
​Make Lab: A fantastic hands-on area showing how things are made. The team here is excellent at explaining concepts, and they run multiple engaging workshops.
​Grow Lab: A lovely terrace space filled with plants and insect habitats, perfect for teaching kids about nature and ecosystems.
​Whether you want to spend a half or full day, this is the perfect spot in Mumbai to learn and explore with your kids. They offer multiple timed slots, making it very convenient to plan your visit. Highly recommended! At the end of the day, kids would be drained out with so much information and new thoughts.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Hrishikesh Doke
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this kids' play zone and found that while the facilities are good, there are some areas that need improvement to enhance the overall experience and safety of children.

1. Overcrowding: The play area was extremely crowded in peak hours, making it difficult for children to enjoy the activities comfortably and safely. Limiting the number of visitors during peak hours or introducing timed slots could help.

2. Insufficient Care Staff: There appeared to be too few staff members supervising the play area. Additional attendants would help monitor children's safety, manage activities better, and assist parents when needed.

3. Parents Inside the Play Area: Many parents were sitting within the play zone itself, creating obstructions and reducing the available space for children to play freely.

Suggestions for Improvement:

- Implement a maximum occupancy limit.
- Increase the number of trained care staff during busy hours.
- Prepare guidelines for kids as well as parents.
- Regularly monitor crowd levels to ensure a safe and enjoyable environment.

With these improvements, the play zone can provide a much better experience for both children and parents.
